profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Keeper Security
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with over 15 years of experience, including architecting scalable backend systems and automated data pipelines. My passion lies in solving complex problems, whether it's revising a legacy system to be 60x faster, cutting cloud infrastructure costs by 90%, or developing custom tools for air-gapped environments. As a project lead and mentor, I enjoy collaborating across teams to elevate code standards and deliver robust, high-performance solutions.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Research and development of cloud based infrastructure hosted in AWS and hybrid on premise infrastructure with RedHat OpenShift

Contract proposal research and development for SAIC Air Force business group for highly collaborative data sharing platforms

Microservice development and deployment for custom mapping software utilizing GIS ingestion

Development of Go based backend API and utilities using go based technologies like OpenAPI generation, sqlc database generation, and high compute concurrency

Developed custom GIS cache tool using OSM slippy map formats including ArcGIS, OpenStreetMap, MapBox, other slippy map servers in order to provide map tiles in an air gapped system
positions.insights: Skills: DevSecOps · Geographic Information Systems (GIS) · ArcGIS Server · Mapbox · Go (Programming Language) · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Proposal Writing · Kubernetes · OpenShift

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
(Business Closed)

Developed scalable API in golang to replace an unscalable and inefficient API, utilized OpenAPI to define and automatically generate endpoints, SQLC to automatically generate data connections with SQL migrations and queries, and GitHub CI/CD to automatically test and release the codebase to GCP Kubernetes clusters

Helped reduce Google Cloud Platform (GCP) costs by 10x by reducing extraneous Kubernetes scaling and reducing data and deployment redundancy
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language) · Go (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · OpenAPI Specification (OAS) · DevOps

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Robotics
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
(Business Closed)

Rearchitected a program in SCALA to reduce run time from over 5 minutes to around 10 seconds and reduce waste of materials 

Wrote new codebase in Java Spring Boot which removed dependencies on outdated and broken code, and used OpenAPI to automatically generate the API based on YAML files 

Developed and maintained Scala and Python code, Docker images, and PostgreSQL databases 

Managed automated testing and deployments with ArgoCD, Kubernetes, and Terraform in AWS ECR

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Integrated 3rd party API and software using C# .NET Core API, dependency injection, technical debt fixes and unification of API logic, and data management with Entity Framework 

Microservice architecture and Docker image development using Microsoft Azure Kubernetes and Helm CI/CD

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a method to extract and analyze HTTPS certificates using a C# backend, and used a machine learning model to analyze the HTTPS certificates against thousands of data points to create a trust scoring system for consumers 

Lead and developed a large-scale data pipeline project with billions of records being generated with a highly scalable and low latency system using Python and Docker on AWS 

Developed multiple analyzation projects using Rust, Python, and C# which utilize cybersecurity data from sources such as the NIST NVD and CVEDB, Domain Tools, WHOIS, ICANN, etc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and deployed a visualization overlay using Google Maps and EmberJS, and a backend system using C# .NET, which gives users visibility of FAA NOTAMs (notices to pilots) and TFRs (no fly zones) on a map 

Developed GIS and Mapping visualization overlays for various data, such as wildfires and weather, using Google Maps and tile-based mapping libraries

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities included design and development of full stack systems for internal use, Android application development, content management, and responsive website redesign, using AngularJS and .NET MVC API framework

Developed the PSA Cert Verification Android app, which is on the Play Store and has over 1,000 users, utilizing Android Studio and Java

Developed a full stack system which utilizes Optical Character Recognition and Web Scraping to determine final sale prices of collectible sports cards, utilizing .NET services and Tesseract OCR

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Increased employee efficiency by developing a Google Chrome Extension, which replaced an antiquated Windows Forms web form filling application. The new extension utilized a REST API and the Chrome Extension Framework

Developed an internal use website which bulk uploaded excel flat files to a MSSQL database, which corrected customers information.

Replaced a nonfunctional Silverlight application with a .NET MVC equivalent. Fixed all bugs associated with the database and data wrapper library.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote documentation and performed unit tests on the in house Android application. The documentation included UML diagrams, User flow charts, Unit Tests, and the software specifications

Developed an encryption library in Java, and ported the encryption library to Objective-C for use in an iPhone application. Wrote an encryption algorithm using SHA HMAC 256

Took over the development of the ESChat Android application, and fixed various bugs associated with porting the application from BlackBerry
